blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generative models synthesize realistic scenes, yet their interactions often violate physics. A ball dropped onto sand should displace grains and settle into a crater, whereas a generated video may show it passing through the surface or leaving the sand flat. Post-hoc methods typically score generated videos with a vision-language model (VLM), but such scores offer limited guidance on which object or parameter to modify, and each correction costs another synthesis. Simulation-based pipelines instead run fixed stages before synthesis, so simulation errors reach the video. To address these limitations, we present PhysMend, a training-free framework for verification-guided program refinement. PhysMend describes the target event as an editable physical program of grounded objects, events, and required relations, paired with tunable execution parameters. Our key insight is to verify and repair the event on its simulated rollout and on the depth video that conditions the generator (depth control) rather than on generated videos, enabling quantitative violation measurement, targeted editing, and fast re-verification before synthesis. A hybrid verifier evaluates semantic event consistency, physical plausibility, solver stability, and visibility in the depth control. VLM judgments are confined to event semantics and cannot override failed physical measurements, which limits the impact of VLM hallucinations. Each failed check localizes the program fields eligible for repair, and its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters. Only accepted depth control reaches the generator, which runs once per input. Experiments on the commonly used benchmarks Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, and VBench-2.0 demonstrate substantial gains across different generator backbones; for example, PhysMend raises the overall Physics-IQ score of Wan-VACE from 27.33 to 39.40.
blocks.zh: 视频基因模型合成了现实的场景,然而它们的相互作用往往违反物理学. 投入沙地的球会取代颗粒并沉入坑中,而生成的视频可能显示它从地表穿过或离开沙地. 后浩克方法一般会用视觉语言模型(VLM)来分分出视频,但这种分数对哪个对象或参数进行修改提供了有限的指导,而每次校正都花费了另一种合成. 基于模拟的管道在合成之前会运行固定的阶段,所以模拟错误到达了视频. 为解决这些局限性,我们提出了PhysMend,这是改进核查指导方案的无培训框架。 PhysMend将目标事件描述为被锚定对象,事件,以及需要的关系的可编辑的物理程序,并配以金枪鱼可执行参数. 我们的关键洞察力是在模拟推出和深度视频上核实和修复事件,这些视频为生成者提供了条件(深度控制),而不是在生成的视频上,从而能够进行定量侵权计量、有针对性地编辑和快速地在合成之前重新核实。 混合验证器在深度控制中评价语义事件的一致性,物理性,解析器稳定性和能见度. VLM判断仅限于事件语义学,不能超越失败的物理测量,这限制了VLM幻觉的影响. 每个失败的检查都会将符合修复条件的程序字段本地化,并且其测量到的违反尺度会对其参数进行有限度的更新. 只有接受的深度控制到达生成器,每输入一次运行. 常用基准物理-IQ,PhyGen Bench,和V Bench-2.0的实验显示不同发电机主干线间有很大的增益;例如,PhysMend将Wan-VACE的总物理-IQ分从27.33分提高到39.40分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generative models have advanced rapidly. Closed-source systems (Sora [ 6 ] , Kling [ 30 ] , Gen-3 [ 49 ] , Seedance [ 51 ] ) and open-source models (Wan [ 57 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 29 ] , CogVideoX [ 68 ] , MiniMax H3 [ 41 ] ) synthesize realistic human activities, natural landscapes, and cinematic scenes. Despite this progress, they struggle to reproduce physically plausible object interactions and motion, such as collisions, contact, support, and trajectory changes, as recent analyses [ 27 , 56 ] and benchmarks such as Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, VideoPhy-2, PhyWorldBench, and PVBench [ 43 , 40 , 4 , 16 , 11 ] report. A ball dropped onto sand must displace grains, form a crater, and come to rest, which is hard to reproduce because sand supports load yet flows under impact. A generated video can look realistic per frame while the ball passes through the surface or the sand stays flat, and poured liquid or falling silk fails similarly. We study physics-aware video generation from an initial image and an event prompt, where material properties, contact conditions, and interaction parameters are unobserved.
blocks.zh: 视频基因模型迅速发展。 闭源系统 (索拉[6],克林[30],Gen-3[49],种子[51])和开源模型(Wan [57],HunyuanVideo [29],CogVideoX [68],MiniMax H3 [41])综合了现实的人类活动,自然景观,以及电影场景. 尽管取得了这些进展,但正如最近的分析[27、56]和基准,如物理-IQ、PhyGen Bench、VideoPhy-2、PhyWorld Bench和PV Bench[43、40、4、16、11]报告,它们仍努力复制物理上可信的物体相互作用和运动,如碰撞、接触、支持和轨迹变化。 投在沙子上的球必须取代谷粒,形成一个陨石坑,然后开始休息,这很难再繁殖,因为沙粒支撑负载,却在撞击下流动。 所生成的视频可以在球穿过表面或沙子保持平坦时,每个帧都看起来现实,并同样倾注液体或落下的丝绸失效. 我们从一个初始的图像和一个事件瞬间来研究物理意识的视频生成,其中材料的属性,接触条件,以及相互作用的参数都是无法观察到的.

blocks.en: Existing methods act either after or before synthesis (Fig. 1 ). After synthesis, PhyT2V [ 65 ] refines its prompt from the generated video, and NEWTON [ 13 ] uses a trained planner to select tools and revise conditioning. This feedback observes the output but relies mostly on VLM verdicts such as “the contact looks wrong” or scalar scores, which offer limited guidance on which object or parameter to modify, and each revision costs another synthesis call. Before synthesis, PhysGen [ 37 ] and PhysMotion [ 55 ] supply simulated motion in fixed stages, so simulation errors reach the video.
blocks.zh: 现有方法要么在合成之后要么在合成之前起作用(图1)。 合成后,PhyT2V [65]从生成的视频中精炼出它的快感,NEWTON [13] 使用训练有素的规划师来选择工具并修改调制. 这种反馈观察了输出,但主要依靠VLM判断,如“接触人看错了”或scalar分数,这些分数对哪些对象或参数可以修改提供了有限的指导,而每一次修订都花费了另一次综合调用。 在合成前,PhysGen [37]和PhysMotion [55]在固定阶段提供模拟运动,因此模拟错误到达视频.

blocks.en:
Recent methods add verification and repair before synthesis [ 33 , 23 , 34 , 64 ] , but their repairs come from retries, execution errors, vision-language diagnoses, or prompt edits rather than from measured violations.
A check reporting that the falling ball missed the sand does not specify whether to adjust its placement, release timing, or initial motion, or by what magnitude. Each edit must be rechecked, since it can break a requirement that already held. A valid rollout also helps only if projection or occlusion does not hide the contact from the generator. Refinement before synthesis must therefore localize what to change and by how much, recheck the event after each edit, and verify what the generator receives.
blocks.zh:
近期的方法在合成[33,23,34,64]之前添加了核查和修复,但其修复来自重复,执行错误,视觉语言诊断,或即时编辑,而不是来自量度的违反.
检查报告掉落的球错过了沙子,没有具体说明是调整其位置,释放时间,还是初始运动,或以何种程度调整. 每次编辑必须重新检查,因为它可能违反已经持有的要求。 只有在投影或封存不隐藏发生器的接触时,有效推出也有所帮助. 因此,在合成前的精细化必须使什么变化和多少变化本地化,每次编辑后重新检查事件,并核实生成器收到什么.

blocks.en: We meet these requirements with PhysMend, a training-free framework for verification-guided program refinement (Fig. 2 ). Its key insight is to verify and repair the event on intermediate representations, namely its simulated rollout and the depth control rendered from it, rather than on generated videos. A prompt can describe an action such as releasing a ball onto sand, but not the physical setup and parameters needed to simulate it, such as object materials and supports or the ball’s initial motion and release time. PhysMend makes these details explicit in an editable physical program Π \Pi of grounded objects, events, and required relations, compiled with tunable execution parameters 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} and simulated in Genesis [ 3 ] . Each rollout and its depth control go through a hybrid verification mechanism that covers event semantics, the physical process, the terminal state, solver stability, and depth-control visibility.
blocks.zh: 我们通过PhysMend满足了这些要求,PhysMend是改进核查指导方案的一个无培训框架(图2)。 其关键见解是验证和修复中间表述上的事件,即模拟推出和从中产生的深度控制,而不是在生成的视频上。 即时可以描述一种动作,如将球放入沙子上,但不能描述模拟它所需的物理设置和参数,如物体材料和支持或球的初始运动和释放时间. PhysMend在可编辑的物理程序 \\\ Pi 中明确这些细节,其中包含被禁物体,事件,和需要的关系,由金枪鱼可执行参数\\\ boldsymbol\theta}编译,并在创世纪[3]中模拟. 每次推出及其深度控制都要通过混合验证机制,涵盖事件语义,物理过程,终端状态,解析器稳定性,深度控制能见度.

blocks.en: Each failed check returns a record naming the affected objects, the checked interval, the violation size, and the editable fields. The record routes structural errors to replanning of Π \Pi and measurable violations to bounded updates of 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} scaled by their size. Every edit is rechecked in simulation, so the program is refined by its own check results, and a rejected edit costs a simulation pass, not another video.
blocks.zh: 每次失败的检查都会返回一个记录, 指定受影响的对象、 检查间隔、 违反大小和可编辑字段 。 重新规划 \\ Pi 和 可测量的违反 \\ boldsymbol\theta} 的 结构错误记录 。 每一次编辑都要在模拟中重新检查,所以程序通过自己的检查结果来完善,一个被拒绝的编辑要花费一个模拟通过,而不是另一个视频.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We present PhysMend, a training-free framework that turns an image and an event prompt into an editable physical program that can be checked on its rollout and depth control and edited before a single video synthesis. • We build a hybrid verification mechanism that checks event semantics, physical processes, terminal states, solver stability, and depth-control visibility, and restricts VLM judgments to event semantics to limit the impact of VLM hallucinations on rollout acceptance. • We design a verification-guided repair mechanism in which each failed check identifies the program fields eligible for repair, its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters, and each revision is rechecked and kept or rolled back within a fixed simulation budget.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们介绍PhysMend,一个将图像和事件迅速转换成可编辑物理程序的无培训框架,可以在推出和深度控制时检查,并在单一视频综合之前编辑。 我们建立混合核查机制,检查事件语义,物理过程,终端状态,解析器稳定性和深度控制能见度,并将VLM判断限制于事件语义,以限制VLM幻觉对推出接受的影响. ^ 我们设计了一个核查制导的修理机制,在这种机制中,每次失败的检查都确定有资格进行修理的程序领域,其测量的违规尺度是对其参数的限定更新,每次修订都经过重新检查,并在固定的模拟预算中保留或回滚。

blocks.en: We present PhysMend, a training-free framework that turns an image and an event prompt into an editable physical program that can be checked on its rollout and depth control and edited before a single video synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出PhysMend,一个将图像和事件迅速转换成可编辑物理程序的无训练框架,可以在推出和深度控制时检查,并在单一视频综合之前编辑。

blocks.en: We build a hybrid verification mechanism that checks event semantics, physical processes, terminal states, solver stability, and depth-control visibility, and restricts VLM judgments to event semantics to limit the impact of VLM hallucinations on rollout acceptance.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了一个混合核查机制,来检查事件语义,物理过程,终端状态,解析器稳定性,以及深度控制能见度,并且将VLM判断限制在事件语义上,以限制VLM幻觉对推出接受的影响.

blocks.en: We design a verification-guided repair mechanism in which each failed check identifies the program fields eligible for repair, its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters, and each revision is rechecked and kept or rolled back within a fixed simulation budget.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个核查制导的修理机制,在这种机制中,每次失败的检查都确定有资格进行修理的程序领域,其测量的违规尺度是对其参数的限定更新,每次修订都经过重新检查,并在固定的模拟预算中保留或回滚。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on Physics-IQ [ 43 ] , PhyGenBench [ 40 ] , and VBench-2.0 [ 75 ] show consistent improvements across backbones, including Wan-VACE [ 57 , 26 ] , Cosmos3-Nano [ 1 ] , and OmniWeaving [ 46 ] . Among the compared methods, PhysMend achieves state-of-the-art performance on both Physics-IQ and PhyGenBench and remains comparable to state-of-the-art methods on VBench-2.0.
blocks.zh: 关于物理-IQ[43],PhyGen Bench[40],V Bench-2.0[75]的广泛实验显示,各骨干之间,包括Wan-VACE[57,26],Cosmos3-Nano[1],以及OmniWeaving[46],都得到了一致的改进. 在比较方法中,PhysMend在物理-IQ和PhyGen Bench上都实现了最先进的性能,并且仍然与V Bench-2.0上最先进的方法相当.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Physics-Aware Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 物理-智能视频生成

blocks.en: Video diffusion models extend image diffusion to temporal sequences [ 19 , 20 ] , with later architectures improving visual fidelity and enabling text- or image-conditioned synthesis [ 5 , 57 , 68 ] , yet physical interactions remain challenging [ 40 , 43 ] . Training-based methods inject physical conditions [ 47 , 59 , 70 ] , transfer relational priors from foundation models [ 28 , 63 , 73 ] , optimize physical rewards and preferences [ 10 , 12 , 71 , 74 ] , or learn neural dynamics of forces, trajectories, and latent states [ 52 , 58 , 69 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频传播模式将图像传播扩展至时间序列[19,20],后期架构改善视觉忠心度,使文本或图像条件合成[5,57,68],但物理互动仍然具有挑战性[40,43]. 基于培训的方法注入物理条件[47、59、70],从基础模型中转移关系前科[28、63、73],优化物理奖励和偏好[10、12、71、74],或学习力量、轨迹和潜伏状态的神经动力[52、58、69]。

blocks.en: Simulation provides a complementary, training-free motion prior. MotionCraft, PhysGen, and PhysMotion animate images with simulated dynamics [ 37 , 42 , 55 ] , while PhysGen3D reconstructs interactive 3D scenes [ 9 ] . RealWonder converts physical actions into optical flow and visual guidance [ 38 ] , and PSIVG reconstructs generated templates for simulation-guided synthesis [ 14 ] . For longer horizons, Fluid-Gen-Zero plans clips from fluid rollouts to guide denoising [ 22 ] , whereas TourPhysics keeps simulated transitions fixed across observation retries [ 72 ] . In contrast, PhysMend verifies and repairs both the simulated rollout and its depth control prior to synthesis.
blocks.zh: 模拟提供了辅助性的、无训练的运动。 MotionCraft,PhysGen,以及模拟动态的PhysMotion动画[37,42,55],而PhysGen3D重建交互式3D场景[9]. RealWonder将物理动作转换为光学流和视觉引导[38],PSIVG重建生成的模板用于模拟制导合成[14]. 对于更长的地平线,Fluid-Gen-Zero计划从流体喷发中进行剪辑以引导去诺化[22],而TourPhysics则保持模拟的过渡固定在观测复试中[72]. 相比之下,PhysMend在合成前验证和修理模拟推出及其深度控制.

blocks.en: 2.2 Planning and Verification for Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 规划和核实视频生成

blocks.en: Pre-generation planning structures the target event before synthesis: VideoDirectorGPT decomposes prompts into layout plans [ 35 ] , VLIPP and CausalMotion plan physical motion [ 67 , 76 ] , and CoECT and its extension model causal event chains [ 61 , 62 ] . PhysPlan grounds state changes in the scene, validates typed graph edits, and guides denoising [ 45 ] , whereas PhysMend simulates the compiled program and measures the rollout and the visibility of its depth control. Post-generation feedback instead revises outputs after synthesis by updating prompts from generated videos [ 39 , 65 ] , adjusting initial noise via flow residuals in Proprio [ 18 ] , coordinating tools with learned policies in NEWTON and VideoGen-Agent [ 13 , 31 ] , or optimizing inference policies in SCOPE [ 25 ] . Rather than tuning a shared policy or regenerating videos, PhysMend refines an event-specific physical program before a single generator call.
blocks.zh: 生成前规划结构 综合前的目标事件: 视频DirectorGPT分解为布局计划[35],VLIPP和CausalMotion计划物理运动[67,76],CoECT及其扩展模型因果事件链[61,62]. PhysPlan的场景状态变化,验证了键入的图表编辑,并引导调试[45],而PhysMend则模拟编译的程序,测量其深度控制的推出和能见度. 生成后反馈则通过更新生成的视频的提示[39,65]来修改合成后的产出,通过流体残存调整Proprio[18]的初始噪声,与NEWTON和VideoGen-Agent[13,31]的学习政策协调工具,或优化SCOPE的推论政策[25]. PhysMend在单个生成器调用之前,不但没有调整共享政策或再生成视频,反而精炼出一个事件特有的物理程序.

blocks.en: Recent works also verify intermediate plans before synthesis. SketchVerify evaluates sketches of candidate motion plans and retries failed ones [ 23 ] , and VideoCoCo repairs Blender scripts via execution feedback before translating drafts with a trained editor [ 33 ] , though syntactic executability alone does not guarantee the intended event. PhysAgent edits physical programs from vision-language diagnoses of reconstructions and rollouts to guide generation with optical flow [ 34 ] . VeriPhy revises scenes before synthesis, but its evaluated video-feedback loop updates the prompt while the control stays fixed [ 64 ] . Unlike repairs driven by retries, execution feedback, or vision-language diagnoses, PhysMend maps each measured violation to a bounded parameter update over localized fields and rechecks both the rollout and its depth control before synthesis.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还在合成前验证中间计划. SketchVerify评价候选人的动画计划草图, Blender 脚本通过执行反馈,在用训练有素的编辑器翻译草稿之前[33],尽管单凭协同可执行性并不能保证预期的事件. 物理代理编辑物理程序,从视觉语言的重建诊断和推出来指导光学流的生成[34]. 维里 Phy在合成前修改场景,但其评价的视频-feedback循环在控制保持固定时更新了提示 [64]. 与由复写,执行反馈,或视觉语言诊断驱动的修复不同,PhysMend地图在局部字段上分别测量了对一个有界限参数更新的违反,并在合成前重新检查推出及其深度控制.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Quantified verification and repair on one representative example from Physics-IQ [ 43 ] . Each rollout is simulated, and the VLM and the physical measurements check every event. At k = 0 k=0 , the simulation is numerically unstable, so no other check is evaluated, and parameter repair raises the solver substeps. At k = 1 k=1 , the program treats the hanging block as a static fixture. The VLM and the physical measurements fail on the block’s events, and replanning makes the block a moving object. At k = 2 k=2 , every check passes, and the frozen generator runs once.
blocks.zh: 图3:对物理学-智商的一个代表性实例进行量化核查和维修[43]。 每次推出都是模拟的,VLM和物理测量检查每个事件. 在 k = 0 k = 0 时, 模拟在数值上是不稳定的, 所以没有其它的检查评价, 参数修补提升了解析器子步骤. 在k = 1 k = 1 时,程序将悬挂块作为静态固定器处理. VLM和物理测量在块的事件上失败,重新规划使块成为移动物体. 在k=2k=2时,每一次检查通过,冷冻发电机运行一次.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Genesis [ 3 ] simulates gravity and contact with rigid primitives for rigid bodies, fixed geometry for supports and containers, the Material Point Method (MPM) [ 53 ] for deformable and granular materials, and Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) [ 15 ] for liquids.

blocks.en: Control-conditioned video generators such as VACE [ 26 ] accept a dense control video in addition to the text prompt and initial frame. The typed physical program Π = ( 𝒪 , ℰ , 𝒵 , 𝒴 ) \Pi=(\mathcal{O},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{Z},\mathcal{Y}) makes explicit which objects take part, in what order events happen, and which relations must hold. The event graph ℰ \mathcal{E} has one node per event, naming its agent, patient, expected effect, and checks, with edges that order events by precondition. The required relations 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} state support, contact, containment, and terminal conditions, and 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} records the source and validation result of each element. For the falling ball, 𝒪 \mathcal{O} holds the grabber, ball, sand, and table, and ℰ \mathcal{E} chains release, fall, and collision, where the collision must contact and deform the sand.
Three pretrained models derive Π \Pi from I 0 I_{0} and p p . SAM 3 [ 8 ] segments the objects that p p names, and Depth Anything V2 [ 66 ] estimates their relative depth, forming camera-aligned 2.5D geometry [ 54 ] . Claude Opus 4.8 [ 2 ] , the VLM used throughout this paper, proposes object roles and the event graph through a schema-constrained interface, and validation rejects missing masks, duplicate identities, conflicting roles, invalid event links, and incompatible physical types before simulation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Physics-IQ [ 43 ] records 66 physical events in solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism from three camera views, giving 198 test samples, each recorded twice to capture natural variation. Given only the event prompt and the switch frame, where the observed context ends, PhysMend generates the next five seconds. Spatial, Spatiotemporal, and Weighted Spatial IoU (SP, ST, WS) measure how well the moving regions overlap with the recording, with ST also evaluating timing and WS weighting by motion duration, while RGB mean squared error (MSE) measures appearance. The overall score combines them after normalizing by the agreement between the two recordings, under both the Original protocol [ 43 ] and Physics-IQ Verified [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: Physics-IQ [43] 从三个相机视角记录了固体力学,流体动力学,光学,热力学,磁学等66个物理事件,给出了198个测试样本,每个样本记录两次以捕捉自然变异. 仅考虑到事件提示和切换框架,在观测到的上下文结束的地方,PhysMend生成接下来的5秒. Space, Spatiotempor, 和Wighted Space IoU(SP, ST, WS) 测量移动区域与录音的重叠程度,ST还按运动持续时间评价时间和WS加权,而RGB表示平方误差(MSE)测量外观. 总体分数在通过两段录音的协议实现正常化后,根据原始协议[43]和物理-IQ验证[50]合并.

blocks.en: PhyGenBench [ 40 ] has 160 prompts covering 27 physical laws in four categories, and its evaluator, PhyGenEval, combines whether the expected phenomenon occurs, whether events follow the right order, and whether the video looks physically natural into a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Each method generates one video per prompt, with a common input image for image-conditioned methods. For VBench-2.0 [ 75 ] , we follow VideoCoCo [ 33 ] and report the three physics categories, Mechanics, Thermotics, and Material, which the official evaluator scores through visual question answering.
blocks.zh: PhyGen Bench [40] 有160个提示,涵盖27种物理定律分为四类,其评价者PhyGenEval结合了预期现象是否发生,事件是否遵循正确的顺序,视频在[0,1] [0,1]中是否物理上自然地看成一个分数. 每一种方法每个提示生成一个视频,并有图像条件化方法的共同输入图像. 对于V Bench -2.0 [75],我们遵循VideoCoCo [33] 并报告三个物理类别,即力学,热学,和材料,官方评价者通过视觉问答评分.

Please refer to the supplementary material for the full implementation details.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: PhysMend improves all three generators under both the Original and Verified protocols (Tab. 1 ). On the Original overall score, the relative gain is largest for Wan-VACE, 44% (from 27.33 to 39.40): alone it scores below most compared methods, but with PhysMend it outperforms every prior physics-aware method in the table, including VLIPP on the same backbone (35.11) and NEWTON (36.89). OmniWeaving gains 14% (from 29.69 to 33.71), and Cosmos3-Nano, the strongest baseline, gains 7% (from 40.76 to 43.67). With Cosmos3-Nano, PhysMend achieves the best value in every column, and with both Wan-VACE and Cosmos3-Nano, every domain improves.
blocks.zh: PhysMend在原始协议和验证协议(Tab. 1 )下改进所有三台发电机. 在原作总分上,Wan-VACE的相对收益最大,为44%(从27.33到39.40): 单是它得分低于大多数比较方法,但随着PhysMend它的表现超过了表中每一个以前的物理认识方法,包括同一主干线上的VLIPP(35.11)和NEWTON(36.89)。 OmniWeating收益14%(从29.69到33.71),Cosmos3-Nano这一最强基线收益7%(从40.76到43.67)。 随着宇宙3-纳诺,PhysMend在每个列中都实现了最佳值,随着Wan-VACE和Cosmos3-纳诺的出现,每个域都得到了改进.

blocks.en: PhysMend improves Cosmos3-Nano by 5% relative (from 0.671 to 0.704), with gains in every category, most in Material and Thermal, and achieves the highest overall score among the methods in Tab. 2 . With Wan-VACE, it outperforms PhyT2V, VLIPP, and the agentic workflows NEWTON and VideoCoCo in every category, and exceeds the latter two by more than 11% relative overall (0.624 vs. 0.560 and 0.558).
blocks.zh: PhysMend将Cosmos3-Nano改进了5%的相对比例(从0.671提高到0.704),每个类别都有增益,大部分在材料和热学方面,并在Tab中的方法中取得了最高的总分. 2. 与Wan-VACE相比,它的表现超过了PhyT2V,VLIPP,代理工作流程中NEWTON和VideoCoCo在每一个类别中,并且比后两个类别的总相对率高出11%以上(0.624对0.560和0.558)。

blocks.en: Without fine-tuning the generator, PhysMend raises the OmniWeaving average by 46% relative (from 52.18 to 76.16), improves all three categories, and nearly doubles the Material score (from 41.67 to 81.54; Tab. 3 ). Its average is comparable to those of VideoCoCo (77.88), which uses a LoRA-tuned editor, and CogVideoX-1.5 (77.04), while its Material score exceeds VideoCoCo’s by more than 13 points (81.54 vs. 68.42). PhysMend reaches this level under a fixed budget of one generator call per input.
blocks.zh: 在不微调生成器的情况下,PhysMend将OmniWeaving平均相对提高了46%(从52.18升至76.16),改善了所有三类,几乎将材料分数翻了一番(从41.67升至81.54;Tab. 3 ) 。 其平均值与VideoCo(77.88)和CogVideoX-1.5(77.04)的平均值相当,而其材料分数则超过了Video Co(77.88)的平均值。 CoCo的成绩超过13分(81.54对68.42). PhysMend在每次输入一个发电机呼叫的固定预算下达到这一水平.

blocks.en: Because the Wan-VACE baseline already receives the expanded prompt p ~ \widetilde{p} , its gain comes from the accepted depth control. Among the Physics-IQ components, its Spatiotemporal IoU rises the most, by 75% relative (from 15.07 to 26.41), so the generated motion overlaps the recording more closely in both space and time. Its largest absolute domain gains occur in fluids and solids, the two domains where physical measurements outperform VLM judgments in the verification ablation (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 由于Wan-VACE基准已经收到扩展的快捷p~\glasstilde{p},其收益来自公认的深度控制. 在Physics-IQ组件中,其Spatiotemporal IoU的上升幅度最大,相对上升75%(从15.07升至26.41),因此产生的运动在空间和时间上都更紧密地重叠了录音. 其最大的绝对域增益发生在流体和固体中,这两个域的物理测量在核查衰减中的表现超过了VLM判断(第4.3条)。

blocks.en: Simulated depth without any checks ( Untyped simulation ) already improves Wan-VACE from 27.33 to 31.20, accounting for about one third of the total gain. Enforcing schema-validated typed programs ( Typed simulation , 34.26), rollout verification ( Verified simulation , 37.21), and closed-loop repair with capability routing ( Full PhysMend , 39.40) each raise the score further in every domain, contributing the remaining two thirds for a 26% relative gain over untyped simulation (from 31.20 to 39.40).
blocks.zh: 无任何检查的模拟深度(无型模拟)已经使Wan-VACE从27.33提高到31.20,占总收益的约三分之一. 执行计程验证的打字程序(Typed模拟,34.26),推出验证(Verifed模拟,37.21),以及带有能力路由的闭路修理(Full PhysMend,39.40),每个领域都进一步提高分数,其余三分之二的分数为26%的相对收益,高于未打字的模拟(从31.20到39.40).

blocks.en: With the same generator, routing, and rollout budget, the hybrid verifier scores highest in every domain and overall, about 6% above measurements alone and 9% above VLM judgments alone (39.40 vs. 37.28 and 36.00). The two sources complement each other across domains: physical measurements score 4% and 7% higher than VLM judgments in solids and fluids, where contact, trajectories, and resting states are measured directly, whereas VLM judgments score 4% to 7% higher in optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism, whose visual effects are not fully captured by geometry and motion measurements alone.
blocks.zh: 混合核查员利用相同的生成器、路径和推出预算,在每个领域和总体评分最高,仅比测量高约6%,仅比VLM判断高9%(39.40对37.28和36.00)。 这两个来源在各个领域互为补充:物理测量得分在固体和流体中比VLM判断高4%和7%,在固体和流体中直接测量接触、轨迹和休息状态,而VLM判断在光学、热力学和磁学中比VLM判断高4%至7%,光是几何和运动测量不能完全捕捉到其视觉效果。

blocks.en: With the same samples, rollout budget, and maximum number of repair attempts, editing only the fields of the failed check ( Localized repair , 38.66) outperforms rebuilding the whole program ( Global rebuild , 37.78) in every domain, and global rebuild improves only slightly on no repair (37.21; Tab. 4 ). Unlike these variants, which always return simulated depth, Full routing (39.40) sends inputs that fail capability checks or are not accepted within the budget to the fallback, adding further gains led by magnetism (from 20.84 to 22.65) and thermodynamics (from 17.24 to 18.22). Together, localized repair and capability routing raise the no-repair score by 6% relative (from 37.21 to 39.40).
blocks.zh: 以同样的样本,推出预算,以及最大限度的修复尝试,只编辑失败检查的字段(本地化的修复,38.66),在每一个域重建整个程序(全球重建,37.78)的成绩都超标,全球重建仅稍有改进,没有修复(37.21;Tab. 4) 与这些变体总是返回模拟深度不同的是,全程(39.40)发送了能力检查失败或预算范围内不接受的输入回落,增加了磁学(从20.84到22.65)和热力学(从17.24到18.22)带动的进一步收益. 局部维修和能力路由使无维修分数相对提高了6%(从37.21提高到39.40)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PhysMend, a training-free framework that verifies and locally repairs typed physical programs before a single pass through a frozen video generator. Its hybrid verifier combines VLM-based event judgments with direct physical and depth-visibility checks to guide residual-scaled updates. Experiments on Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, and VBench-2.0 demonstrate consistent gains across video generative models with different architectures. Among the compared methods, PhysMend achieves state-of-the-art results on Physics-IQ and PhyGenBench and remains comparable to state-of-the-art methods on VBench-2.0 under a fixed generation budget.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PhysMend, 一个免费的训练框架, 在一次通过一个冷冻的视频生成器前, 验证和局部修复输入物理程序。 其混合验证器将基于VLM的事件判断与直接的物理和深度可见度检查相结合,以指导剩余尺度更新. 物理-IQ,PhyGen Bench,和V Bench-2.0的实验显示,不同架构的视频基因模型的一致收益. 在比较方法中,PhysMend在物理学-IQ和PhyGen Bench上取得了最先进的结果,在固定生成预算下仍然与V Bench-2.0上最先进的方法相当.

blocks.en: A.1 Program Representation and Grounding
blocks.zh: A.1 方案代表性和定位

blocks.en: The physical program is Π = ( 𝒪 , ℰ , 𝒵 , 𝒴 ) , \Pi=(\mathcal{O},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{Z},\mathcal{Y}), (5) where 𝒪 \mathcal{O} is the grounded object set, ℰ \mathcal{E} the event graph, 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} the required support, contact, containment, and terminal relations, and 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} the record of each element’s source and validation result. Each event specifies its participants, preconditions, dependencies, expected effect, physical primitives, and checks.
blocks.zh: 物理程序是 = = (O, E, Z, Y),\ Pi= (\ mathcal{O},\ mathcal{E},\ mathcal{Z},\ mathcal{Y}), (5) 其中 O\ mathcal{O} 是被禁对象集, E\ mathcal{E} 事件图表, Z\ mathcal{Z} 需要的支持, 联系, 封存, 和终端关系, Y\ mathcal{Y} 每一个元素的来源和验证结果的记录 。 每个事件都指定了参与者,先决条件,依赖性,预期效果,物理原始,以及检查.

blocks.en: The inputs are an initial image I 0 I_{0} and a text prompt p p that describes the physical event to generate. Grounding links this description to the scene: each entity that p p names receives a persistent identity, a visible mask, a confidence value, relative depth, and support or containment cues. Every object record stores id, mask identifier, class name, semantic role, physical type, material category, state phases, initial motion, support relations, contact relations, and provenance. Every event record stores event id, event type, agent, patient, physical primitives, preconditions, causal dependencies, expected effect, and required status.
blocks.zh: 输入是一个初始图像 I 0 I_{0 } 和一个文字提示 p 来描述要生成的物理事件 。 定位将这一描述与现场联系起来:p名称的每个实体都得到一个持续的身份,一个可见的面具,一个信任值,相对深度,以及支持或封存提示. 每个对象记录存储id,面具标识符,类名,语义角色,物理类型,材料类别,状态阶段,初始运动,支持关系,联系关系,以及出处. 每个事件记录存储事件id,事件类型,代理,病人,物理原始,先决条件,因果关系,预期效果,以及需要的状态.

blocks.en: Grounding combines object masks from SAM 3 [ 8 ] , relative depth from Depth Anything V2 [ 66 ] , and roles and event structure proposed by Claude Opus 4.8 [ 2 ] , the vision-language model (VLM) used throughout this paper. Together with visible relations, these estimates define camera-aligned 2.5D geometry [ 54 ] . Validation rejects missing masks, duplicate identities, role conflicts, invalid event links, incompatible physical types, and primitives absent from the capability registry. VLM output never reaches the simulator without this validation.

blocks.en: The renderer removes moving pixels from the initial depth map, reconstructs the static background depth, rasterizes objects and particles into the camera view, and resolves visibility. Splatting points together with their object labels, normalizing depth over the whole clip, and Gaussian smoothing [ 54 ] with a one-pixel standard deviation then produce the dense control sequence. Control checks reject wrong direction, reversed order, missing events, empty frames, absent dynamic foreground, severe flicker, static control for a dynamic target, and an invalid final visible state.

blocks.en: Control is checked separately from simulation because a rollout can pass the particle ledger while the camera view does not show the outcome. In a pouring case, 96.11% of the particles reach the receiver, yet the receiver appears only shallowly filled in the camera view.
blocks.zh: 控件与模拟是分开检查的,因为推出可以传递粒子分类账,而相机视图则不显示结果. 在倾注的情况下,96.11%的颗粒到达接收器,然而接收器在镜头视图中只出现浅层填充.

blocks.en: The default generator is frozen Wan-based VACE (Wan-VACE) [ 57 , 26 ] . For it, the T s = 80 T_{s}=80 exported simulation frames at 16 fps become T g = 81 T_{g}=81 generator frames by repeating the last depth frame. The generator receives the initial image, the expanded prompt, and the accepted depth control, and its weights ϕ \phi stay frozen. The fallback uses the same generator, sampling settings, and seed with the image and expanded prompt but no depth, so every input receives one final RGB output.

blocks.en: C.1 Benchmark Protocols
blocks.zh: C.1 基准议定书

blocks.en: Physics-IQ [ 43 ] contains 66 scenarios across solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism. Each scenario is filmed from three camera views, which gives 198 samples, one per scenario and view, and each recording has two real takes. Under the Original protocol, we score 80-frame, five-second continuations at 16 fps. PhysMend receives the event prompt and the switch frame, at which the observed context ends; the recorded continuations are used only for evaluation. The Cosmos3-Nano [ 1 ] and OmniWeaving [ 46 ] baselines use their image-to-video (I2V) settings, and Sec. D describes the OmniWeaving interface used with PhysMend. CoECT [ 62 ] is reported both with a generated first frame and with an observed frame from the benchmark. Physics-IQ Verified revises the benchmark data, prompts, and sample-level scoring [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: Physics-IQ [43] 包含66种跨固体力学,流体动力学,光学,热力学,磁学的情景. 每个场景都从三个镜头视图中拍摄出来,可以给出198个样本,每个场景和视图各一个,每个录制有2个真实的镜头. 根据原始协议,我们得分为80帧,5秒的续作为16 fps. PhysMend接收事件提示和切换框,在切换框中观察上下文结束;所记录的续作仅用于评价. Cosmos3-Nano [1] 和 OmniWeave [46] 基线使用其图像到视频(I2V)设置,Sec. D描述与PhysMend使用的OmniWeave接口. CoECT [62]的报告既带有生成的第一个框架,也含有从基准中观察到的框架。 Physics-IQ 验证后修改基准数据,提示,和样本级评分[50].

blocks.en: PhyGenBench [ 40 ] contains 160 prompts covering 27 physical laws, with 40, 50, 30, and 40 prompts in Mechanics, Optics, Thermal, and Material, respectively. The protocol generates one video per prompt in the official order, with a common image source for image-conditioned methods. We report normalized PhyGenEval scores on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , where higher is better.
blocks.zh: PhyGen Bench [40] 包含160个促进器,涵盖27个物理定律,分别有40个,50个,30个和40个促进器在力学,光学,热学,和材料学. 协议按正式顺序每个提示生成一个视频,并带有图像条件化方法的共同图像源. 我们报告PhyGenEval在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 的正常得分, 高点更好.

blocks.en: VBench-2.0 [ 75 ] evaluates 18 dimensions across human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense. We report only its physics categories and adopt VideoCoCo’s three-category protocol [ 33 ] : Mechanics covers mechanical behavior, Thermotics covers thermal state changes, and Material covers properties such as mixing and solubility.
blocks.zh: V Bench-2.0 [75]评价了人类忠诚,可控性,创造力,物理,常识等18个维度. 我们只报告物理类别,采用VideoCoCo的三类协议[33]: 机械学涵盖机械行为,热学涵盖热态变化,材料涵盖混合和溶解等特性.

blocks.en: E.1 System Components
blocks.zh: E.1 系统组件

blocks.en: This study asks whether simulated depth alone accounts for the improvement. Starting from Wan-VACE with the expanded prompt p ~ \widetilde{p} , we add simulated depth without checks, program validation and capability checks, rollout verification, and finally repair with capability routing. Untyped simulation builds an executable simulation from an unconstrained scene description and renders its first executable rollout without checks. Typed simulation adds the typed program and capability checks but does not verify the rollout. Verified simulation verifies the rollout but does not modify a failed program. Full PhysMend adds repair and sends inputs that fail capability checks or never pass to the fallback. All variants use the same generation settings and return one output per sample.
blocks.zh: 本研究询问模拟深度本身是否是改进的原因. 从Wan-VACE开始,以扩展的快速p~\glashtilde{p}开始,我们添加模拟深度而不检查,程序验证和能力检查,推出验证,最后用能力路由修复. 无类型模拟从一个不受约束的场景描述中构建一个可执行的模拟,并使得其第一次可执行的推出无需检查. 型号模拟增加了型号程序和能力检查,但不验证推出. 校验模拟验证推出,但不修改失败的程序. Full PhysMend 添加修复,并发送失败能力检查或永不传递到倒置的输入. 所有变种都使用相同的生成设置,每个样本返回一个输出.

blocks.en: E.3 Repair and Capability Routing

blocks.en: This study asks how the response to a failed check affects the final output. All variants use the same Physics-IQ samples, rollout budget, and maximum number of repair attempts. No repair rejects a failed rollout without editing its program, global rebuild recreates the whole program, and localized repair edits only the fields Ω j \Omega_{j} of the failed check. These three variants always use simulation and return simulated depth even if no rollout passes. Full routing uses localized repair and, as in Alg. 2 , sends inputs that fail capability checks or never pass to the fallback.

blocks.en: E.4 Control Representation
blocks.zh: E.4 控制代表性

blocks.en: To examine how the motion representation affects generation, we compare image and text, coarse guidance, raw simulation depth, and verified dense depth with a shared Wan-VACE generator. Coarse guidance uses sparse keyframes or projected object trajectories without dense spatial control. Raw simulation depth renders the simulated scene to depth without visibility correction, background reconstruction, normalization, smoothing, or control checks. Verified dense depth is full PhysMend: it uses the full control construction, and only rollouts that pass all checks send their depth control to the generator.
blocks.zh: 为了研究运动表现如何影响生成,我们用一个共享的Wan-VACE生成器来比较图像和文本,粗细的导线,原始模拟深度,以及验证的密集深度. 粗糙的制导使用稀疏的键框或没有密集空间控制的投射物体轨迹. 原始模拟深度使得模拟场景在不可见度校正,背景重建,正常化,平滑,或控制检查的情况下进入深度. 验证的密集深度是全PhysMend:它使用全控构造,只有通过所有检查的推出才能将它们的深度控制发送到生成器.

Simulation and verification are separate operations: the default algorithm allows one initial rollout and up to three correction rollouts, but invokes the generator only after accepting control or choosing image-and-prompt fallback. A rejected program revision therefore costs another simulation and verification pass without another RGB synthesis.

blocks.en: All three motion videos improve on I2V, showing that explicit motion guidance remains useful for Seedance 2.5 (Tab. 11 ). Depth provides the largest gain, raising the Physics-IQ score from 41.29 to 49.66, an improvement of 8.37 percentage points. Its Spatiotemporal IoU also increases from 0.1688 to 0.3106 on the raw overlap scale, so the generated motion matches the recording better in both location and timing. Particle and coarse-RGB videos also help, but neither matches the depth condition, so the gain depends on how the motion is represented, not only on supplying another video.

blocks.en: The default generator is frozen Wan-VACE [ 57 , 26 ] . As a baseline, Wan-VACE alone receives I 0 I_{0} and the expanded prompt p ~ \widetilde{p} without depth control. To test other control interfaces, we also pair PhysMend with Cosmos3-Nano [ 1 ] , which takes the depth control through its built-in depth conditioning without additional LoRA weights [ 21 ] , and with OmniWeaving [ 46 ] , which takes it as a video input in its unified tiv2v mode. We compare with direct generators [ 68 , 17 , 5 ] , prompt and event planners [ 65 , 62 , 67 , 23 ] , motion-control methods [ 44 , 7 ] , and agentic workflows [ 13 , 33 ] , and run NEWTON and SketchVerify on Physics-IQ with their public code.

blocks.en: Appendix K Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录K 限制

blocks.en: PhysMend builds its simulation from estimated masks and relative depth, so occlusion, transparency, and hidden surfaces can affect the simulated contacts. Its coverage is bounded by the materials, interactions, and checks that the simulator and verifier support, and depth control carries geometry and motion but not temperature, phase, or optical state. Extending the simulator, the check set, and the control signals is a main direction for future work.
blocks.zh: PhysMend通过估计的口罩和相对深度来建立其模拟,因此隐蔽性,透明度,以及隐藏的表面可以影响模拟接触. 其覆盖范围以材料、相互作用、模拟器和核查器支持的检查以及深度控制为界,它们包含几何和运动,但不包含温度、相或光学状态。 扩展模拟器,检查集,控制信号是未来工作的主要方向.
